FN-5TXWMM6-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 119
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Will Barfoot
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/12/2025
Senate Bill 119 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Department of Corrections,
by an undetermined amount, dependent upon the number of parolee and probationers that
violate the provisions of this bill and return to the Department of Corrections to serve the
balance of their sentence.
In addition, this could increase receipts to the State General Fund from fines; increase receipts to
the State General Fund, county general funds and other funds to which court costs are deposited;
and could increase the obligations of the State General Fund, district attorneys, the Bureau of
Pardons and Paroles, the Department of Corrections, and community corrections programs by an
undetermined amount dependent upon the number of persons charged with and convicted of the
offenses provided by the bill and the penalties imposed.

FN-5TXWMM6-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 119
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Will Barfoot
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/15/2025
Senate Bill 119 as passed the Senate could increase the obligations of the Department of
Corrections by an undetermined amount dependent upon the cost to house any parolee and
probationers that violate the provisions of this bill and return to the Department of Corrections
to serve the balance of their sentence.
In addition, this could increase receipts to the State General Fund from fines; increase receipts to
the State General Fund, county general funds and other funds to which court costs are deposited;
and could increase the obligations of the State General Fund, district attorneys, the Bureau of
Pardons and Paroles, the Department of Corrections, and community corrections programs by an
undetermined amount dependent upon the number of persons charged with and convicted of the
offenses provided by the bill and the penalties imposed.
